case_number: 2024 INSC 125; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. ______ OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (CRL.) NO. 2052 OF 2017)
summary: Appeal against condonation of delay in appeal from acquittal; limitation period under Section 378(5) CrPC; distinction between Kaushalya Rani (1964) vs Mangu Ram (1976) on applicability of Section 5 Limitation Act; Section 5 applicable under current Limitation Act 1963 absent express exclusion; High Court erred in condoning 72-day delay; impugned order setting aside condonation restored.
legal_provisions_cited: Kaushalya Rani v. Gopal Singh (1964) 4 SCR 982
Mangu Ram v. Municipal Corporation of Delhi (1976) 1 SCC 392
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's condonation of delay set aside; original acquittal order restored.
